deribit.intervals: Continuously calculated and paid/received; quoted as 8-hour interest rate; cash balance settled daily at 08:00 UTC. Historical endpoint returns hourly interest_1h and interest_8h observations.
deribit.sign: Positive: long pays short. Negative: short pays long.
deribit.surcharge: None: venue says it charges no fee on funding, transfers between holders.
